text:
We're a small team, and we recently moved our CI to a new provider. I'd like to say it went exactly to plan, but I don't think any migration does.

The buildbot dashboard came up partway through. It's one of those things that's easy to overlook until a migration forces you to ask what it was doing for you and whether anyone still depends on it. That question alone was worth the detour, because it made us look at parts of our setup we hadn't thought about in a while.

With a team our size, there's no dedicated group to hand this kind of work to. Everyone who touches the pipeline ends up learning how it actually works, not how we remember it working. That's uncomfortable at first, but I'd take it over the alternative.

I'm still sorting out what I'd do differently next time. Mostly I'm curious about everyone else's experience.

If you've migrated CI before, what was the thing that surprised you most?
